notes.title: Play HIGHPOINT at Steam Sports Fest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890324/98121fea07f5c5e022c9099eb9054ecb024187dc.jpg[/img]Play Highpoint [b]RIGHT NOW[/b] at Steam Sports Fest (May 15-21)!

Download the Demo from our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1556400/HIGHPOINT/]Store Page[/url] and enjoy a week-long, Open Preview of HIGHPOINT! This is still a very early, work-in-progress build so you may see some rough edges and hiccups but we hope you'll love the foundation we're building!

HIGHPOINT is multiplayer only so it's a good idea to head over to our Discord to find other players and games, talk shop, share clips, and more! We're SO excited to have you join us!
[url=discord.gg/jrJ8Mu4sqd]HIGHPOINT Discord[/url]

So what are you waiting for?! Get to downloading, grab your friends, and meet us on the court!!
<3, Wildbloom
